title: menu-redesign: single «Меню» dropdown (vertical, sideways submenus, MRU of last-5 commands) replacing the Файл/Правка menubar in AudioPage; Export moves from the toolbar into Файл→Экспорт with a type+filename dialog

decisions.text: Single «Меню» dropdown. The two top-level q-btn-dropdowns in AudioPage.vue's .audio-page__menubar (:5-28) — «Файл» (t('audio.menuFile'), one item «Открыть…» -> openFileDialog) and «Правка» (t('audio.editMenu'), one item «Настройки» -> goToSettings, Ctrl+P) — are REPLACED by ONE q-btn-dropdown with label t('audio.menuRoot') («Меню»), whose popup is a vertical q-list. Content is built from a DECLARATIVE menu model (MR-D2) so sideways submenus + the MRU section are data-driven and extensible (owner req. 3: every item may have a submenu). Owner reqs 1,2,5.

Menu model + recursive render. A model array of nodes { id, labelKey, icon?, shortcut?, run?(): void, children?: MenuNode[], disabled?: () => boolean } plus a FLAT registry keyed by id (for the MRU lookup). Render: a q-item per node; a node WITH children renders a nested Quasar submenu — an inner <q-menu anchor="top end" self="top start"> (the standard sideways-submenu pattern) plus a chevron_right icon on the right; a LEAF (has run) is a clickable q-item with v-close-popup; disabled?() reactively greys/blocks an item (Экспорт uses !canExportCurrentFile). Initial model: Файл -> [Открыть, Экспорт], Настройки (leaf), Выход (leaf). Keeping it data-driven means adding future submenus (owner req. 3) is a model edit, not new template. HOVER-OPEN (owner req. 8, 2026-07-14): a container's q-menu is no-parent-event; @mouseenter on the item shows its submenu after SUBMENU_HOVER_DELAY_MS=120ms (barely perceptible) and hides sibling submenus at the same level, @mouseleave cancels the pending timer; a click opens it immediately. Per-AppMenuList-instance Map<id,QMenu> holds the submenu refs; the timer is cleared in onBeforeUnmount.

Leaf actions. Открыть -> openFileDialog() (opens the file panel). Экспорт -> openExportDialog() (MR-D7). Настройки -> goToSettings() (the two-pane settings dialog; the existing Ctrl+P handler in handlePlayerKeyDown stays unchanged). Выход -> window.close() (owner req. 6: close the AppCore host window; detached panel windows already use window.close(), same mechanism; in a dev browser window.close() only affects script-opened windows -> effectively a no-op there, a dev-only limitation). Every leaf runs through ONE wrapper invokeMenuCommand(node) that (a) calls node.run() and (b) records node.id into the MRU (MR-D4), so a single code path feeds both the click and the MRU. A disabled?() leaf neither runs nor records.

MRU of the last 5 commands (owner req. 4, clarified 2026-07-14 = menu COMMANDS, not recent files). A composable useMenuMru() in GnauralCore/ui/composables/use-menu-mru.ts: reactive ids: string[], persisted to localStorage under 'mindwave-menu-mru'; push(id) = dedup + prepend + truncate to 5 (most-recent-first). Render: a q-separator AFTER «Выход», then the MRU rows (label/icon resolved from the flat registry by id); clicking a row calls the same invokeMenuCommand (which re-bumps it to the top). Empty MRU -> neither the separator nor the section render. Only LEAF commands enter the MRU (container nodes like «Файл» never do). «Выход» IS a command so by the literal requirement it enters the MRU too — FLAG: if the owner dislikes that a stray click on a recent item could close the app, exclude 'exit' from the MRU later.

i18n. New keys audio.menuRoot («Меню» / 'Menu') and audio.menuExit («Выход» / 'Exit'). Reused: menuFile («Файл»), menuOpen («Открыть…»), openSettings («Настройки»). The audio.editMenu key («Правка») is REMOVED with its dropdown (owner req. 5). audio.recentFiles* keys are untouched — that is a separate on-form control, not the menu MRU.

Code placement. The menu markup + invokeMenuCommand live in AudioPage.vue (where the menubar already is). The menu model is a local const/computed in AudioPage setup (it closes over openFileDialog/goToSettings/openExportDialog). The MRU is a standalone composable (use-menu-mru.ts) so it is unit-testable. Multi-repo rule: code -> GnauralCore repo, this Plan+Ledger -> MindWaveCore repo, staged/committed separately.

Export moves into the menu + a dialog (owner req. 7, 2026-07-14). REMOVE the «Экспорт» dropdown button from GnauralTransportControls.vue (the showExport prop, its wav/flac q-items, the export emit) and its three bindings in AudioPage (:show-export/:export-disabled/:export-loading/@export at ~:275, :325, :362). ADD a leaf Меню -> Файл -> Экспорт with disabled=!canExportCurrentFile (gnaural-only, same gate as today). Clicking opens an EXPORT DIALOG (q-dialog, new component ExportDialog.vue or an inline dialog in AudioPage): a TYPE control (wav | flac radio/select) + a FILE NAME q-input prefilled from buildExportFileName(path, format) and re-derived when the type changes (swap the extension), plus Отмена / Экспорт buttons. Экспорт calls the existing downloadSelectedAudio(format) but link.download uses the entered name; keep the existing prepareForExternalMutation save-first guard + error handling. Choosing a real save FOLDER is out of scope (the browser <a download> lands in Downloads); a File System Access API showSaveFilePicker upgrade is a later option (flag). New i18n: audio.exportDialogTitle, audio.exportFormat, audio.exportFileName, audio.exportAction, audio.exportCancel; existing export/exportWav/exportFlac/exportFailed reused or cleaned up.
